review_candidates.title: Project Coordinator
review_candidates.description: Hiring for Projects Coordinator in Dubai Main Responsibilities 1. Project Documentation & Administration · Maintain and organize all project-related documents and records. · Maintain proper filing of drawings, specifications, contracts, correspondence, approvals and submissions. · Prepare and maintain project registers and trackers. · Ensure all documents are properly updated and easily accessible. · Maintain records of incoming and outgoing correspondence. 2. Project Programme & Progress Tracking · Assist the Project Manager in preparing and updating the project programme. · Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports. 3. Drawings & Submittal Coordination · Maintain the drawing register and ensure the latest revisions are properly recorded. · Follow up with consultants, subcontractors and suppliers regarding drawings and technical submissions. · Track shop drawings, material submittals, RFIs, method statements and approvals. · Monitor consultant comments and ensure they are forwarded to the responsible team for action. · Follow up on pending approvals and revisions. 4. Procurement & Material Follow-Up · Coordinate with the procurement department regarding project material requirements. · Follow up on material approvals, purchase orders and delivery dates. · Monitor critical materials and inform the Project Manager of potential delays. 5. Subcontractor & Supplier Coordination · Maintain records of subcontractors and suppliers. · Follow up on subcontractor commitments, schedules and deliverables. · Coordinate required documentation from subcontractors. 6. Client & Consultant Coordination · Assist the Project Manager with client and consultant correspondence. · Track consultant/client comments and ensure timely responses. · Coordinate submission of required documents and reports. 7. Inspection & Approval Tracking · Maintain inspection and approval trackers. · Coordinate with the site team regarding inspection requests. · Follow up on consultant inspection results and comments. · Track outstanding NCRs, observations and corrective actions. · Monitor closure of outstanding items. 8. Commercial & Payment Coordination · Coordinate with the commercial/accounts team regarding project-related documents. · Follow up on subcontractor payment documentation and supporting documents. · Track client payment applications, invoices and related submissions where required. · Maintain records of approved variations, additional works and related correspondence. 9. Reporting Prepare and maintain: · Daily/weekly progress reports. · Weekly project dashboards. · Material procurement trackers. · Drawing and submittal registers. · RFI trackers. · Inspection trackers. 10. Key Skills Required · Strong organization and follow-up skills. · Excellent Excel and Microsoft Office skills. · Good knowledge of project documentation and construction procedures. · Good written and verbal communication. · Ability to manage multiple trackers and deadlines. · Ability to coordinate with consultants, subcontractors, suppliers and internal departments. · Attention to detail. · Ability to identify delays and escalate issues before they become critical. Education Required · Bachelor in Civil Engineering

review_candidates.title: Programme Funding Portfolio Development Specialist, MENAEE

Team Purpose To provide strategic leadership and direction on all Programme Funding matters across Save the Children. Optimise and align our local-to-global programme funding portfolio and drive continuous improvements in our capabilities, funding practices and donor partnerships. Blend art and science to turn insights into action. Collaborate extensively across the movement, and partner closely with key stakeholders, both within and beyond StC, to directly inform, shape, and connect key strategic programme funding trends and initiatives that advance the movement's Global Strategy and Global Funding Framework ambitions. Role purpose To provide portfolio development support and guidance that, through collaboration with Country Offices and Members, helps shape and strengthen Country Strategy-aligned Programme Funding. This globally available, MENAEE-focused Portfolio Development Specialist role supports the growth, diversification and strategic alignment of programme funding portfolios across multiple countries and markets. It does this through portfolio optimisation, market and donor analysis, strategic planning, and the identification of funding opportunities, risks and priorities that require cross-country coordination and insight. By actively collaborating with Implementing Country Offices, Members, Regional Hubs and global colleagues, the role promotes a systematic, high-quality and consistent approach to programme funding and donor partnerships, translating market intelligence into actionable guidance and supporting stronger portfolio performance across the region. Through this work, the role contributes to the achievement of Save the Children's local-to-global strategic objectives. This role complements but does not replace Country Office and Member business development functions, which retain ownership of their pipelines, donor relationships, and proposal acquisition. Relationship Management: Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with colleagues, members, external partners, and donors. Values diversity and collaboration as sources of strength. Communication: Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively to different audiences. Proposal Development: Expertise in guiding the preparation and submission of high-quality and competitive funding proposals, including strong writing, editing, and project management skills. Financial Acumen: Solid understanding of financial planning, budget management, and donor compliance requirements. Negotiation and Influencing: Strong negotiation skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at different levels. Desirable Skills Leadership: Proven leadership skills with the ability to inspire and guide cross-functional teams, fostering a culture of accountability, ambition, creativity, and integrity. Problem-Solving: Ability to develop and encourage new and innovative solutions, while willing to take disciplined risks. Essential Education and Qualifications Education: Educated to degree level or equivalent professional experience - in international development, business administration, economics, marketing, or a related field. Other relevant languages would also be a distinct advantage. CPD: Commitment to continuous professional development to stay updated with the latest trends in programme funding and business development. Travel: Willingness and ability to travel to different country offices as required. We know that great people make a great organisation, and that our employees play a crucial role in helping us achieve our ambitions for children. We value our people and offer a meaningful and rewarding career, along with a collaborative and inclusive environment where ambition, creativity, and integrity are highly valued. The work here is challenging but is also immensely rewarding. At Save the Children, you will be in good company, working with talented, like-minded individuals who are determined to ensure that all children survive, learn, and are protected. Candidates who are successfully shortlisted should expect to hear from us within 2 weeks of the advert deadline. review_candidates.title: Hoofduitvoerder Middenspanning
review_candidates.description: Organisatie- en afdelingsomschrijving Werk mee aan de energie-infrastructuur van de toekomst als Engineer Energie. Je komt terecht bij een gevestigde technische organisatie die een belangrijke rol speelt in de uitbreiding en vernieuwing van het Nederlandse elektriciteitsnet. Vanuit verschillende disciplines werken technische specialisten hier samen aan projecten binnen de midden- en hoogspanning. De projecten lopen uiteen van aanpassingen aan bestaande installaties tot omvangrijke nieuwbouw- en uitbreidingsprojecten voor grote partijen binnen de Nederlandse energievoorziening. Geen standaardwerk dus, maar projecten waarin techniek, veiligheid en een goede voorbereiding echt samenkomen. Als Hoofduitvoerder krijg je veel vertrouwen en verantwoordelijkheid. Je werkt met ervaren vakmensen, hebt korte lijnen met de voorbereiding en projectleiding en krijgt de ruimte om zelf beslissingen te nemen in de uitvoering. Ook voor de langere termijn is dit een interessante werkgever. Door de hoeveelheid projecten en technische disciplines zijn er volop mogelijkheden om door te groeien, opleidingen te volgen of jezelf verder te specialiseren binnen de energietechniek. Zoek je een stabiele werkgever, uitdagende projecten én een omgeving waarin jouw ervaring als uitvoerder echt wordt gewaardeerd? Dan is dit zeker een organisatie om eens mee kennis te maken. Ben jij klaar om je loopbaan in de energietransitie écht vaart te geven? Neem contact op met Michel Dirks via 06-3003 5990 of mail naar m.dirks@multiselect.nl — dan bespreken we samen hoe jij kunt doorgroeien in de sector van de toekomst! Functie-informatie Als Hoofduitvoerder ben jij degene die ervoor zorgt dat het buiten goed geregeld is. Je bent betrokken vanaf de voorbereiding en denkt vroegtijdig mee over de aanpak en uitvoerbaarheid van een project. Zodra het project in uitvoering gaat, houd jij de regie. Je stuurt monteurs en uitvoerende collega's aan, bewaakt de voortgang en hebt regelmatig overleg met de werkvoorbereider en projectleider. Je werkt aan elektrotechnische installaties binnen de midden- en hoogspanning. Hierbij kun je denken aan kabelverbindingen, transformatoren, schakelinstallaties en de bijbehorende beveiligings- en besturingssystemen. Jouw Werkzaamheden Zijn Onder Andere Coördineren van de dagelijkse werkzaamheden op projectlocaties; Aansturen en begeleiden van monteurs en andere uitvoerende partijen; Vooraf beoordelen van werkzaamheden en projectlocaties; Organiseren van de benodigde mensen, materialen en middelen; Bewaken van planning, budget, kwaliteit en voortgang; Signaleren en oplossen van knelpunten tijdens de uitvoering; Controleren of werkzaamheden volgens de geldende veiligheidsregels worden uitgevoerd; Afstemmen met werkvoorbereiding, projectleiding en opdrachtgever; Bijhouden van de projectadministratie en zorgen voor een goede afronding en overdracht. Je krijgt daarbij veel eigen verantwoordelijkheid. Loopt iets anders dan gepland? Dan wacht je niet af, maar zoek je samen met het team naar een praktische oplossing. Aanbod Salaris tussen €4.500 en €6.500 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring en opleiding. Uitdagende projecten op het gebied van duurzame energieverbindingen. Werken bij een vooraanstaande organisatie met volop groeimogelijkheden. Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder een telefoon en auto van de zaak. 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen. Functie-eisen Voor deze functie zoeken we iemand die de wereld van middenspanning kent en zich prettig voelt in een verantwoordelijke rol buiten op het project. Je Beschikt Bij Voorkeur Over Een mbo 4-opleiding Elektrotechniek, Energietechniek of vergelijkbaar; Ervaring met midden- en/of hoogspanningsinstallaties; Ervaring als Uitvoerder, Hoofduitvoerder of in een vergelijkbare functie; Relevante elektrotechnische certificeringen; Ervaring met het begeleiden en aansturen van technische medewerkers. Daarnaast ben je duidelijk in je communicatie, praktisch ingesteld en blijf je rustig wanneer er tijdens de uitvoering onverwachte situaties ontstaan. Veilig werken is voor jou vanzelfsprekend. Solliciteren bij Michel Dirks is jouw contactpersoon bij Multiselect en staat klaar om je verder te helpen in jouw carrière als Hoofduitvoerder Middenspanning in de regio Den Haag. Met jarenlange ervaring in personeelsbemiddeling begrijpt Michel jouw ambities en weet hij de juiste match te maken. Neem contact op met Michel via 06-3003 5990 of stuur je cv naar m.dirks@multiselect.nl. Solliciteer

review_candidates.title: Hands-on Delivery Planner (Data Centres/Buildings/High-tech/Infrastructure) - Norway (Hybrid)
review_candidates.description: Are you a bit tired of the standard, old-fashioned way of doing things in the construction industry? Do you get deep satisfaction from making things run more efficiently using a good dose of common sense and maybe a bit of technology? Have you always cared about the importance of proper planning and the connection between the schedule and the real, day-to-day delivery of the job? Have you ever wanted to work a bit more flexibly but still be hands-on in construction and improving the industry? Sounds like a dream. Well, it isn’t. It’s quite real! Read on. ____________________________________________________________ We are Laminar Projects! If you’ve already heard about us, you’re probably reading this because you’re tired of the typical, chaotic ways of doing things in construction. But in case you haven’t, we’re a high-end project management consultancy and tech developer with a focus on upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. ( Check out our short film about it. ) We bring transparency and control to projects through a pragmatic mix of the latest tech, our own processes, and a big dose of common sense. We then take our deep understanding of these projects and we invest heavily into developing the digital solutions that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. ( Check out Shape, our construction management tech, to see what we’re doing.) The core of all this is our true secret sauce: our people. We only recruit the very best, both in capability and personality. We’re deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that’s optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People who join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. ( Read more about our vision and missions .) This approach has allowed us to grow from just two people in 2017 to over 220 today. We have a stable, repeat client base across infrastructure and complex building projects in the UK and internationally, and we’re still growing fast. Joining us isn’t just some “job”. It’s a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. There are many diverse and interesting challenges available. It’s up to you to guide yourself into whichever areas you’re most interested – we’ll enable it. ( Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos. ) Core values for a good life A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has: Grow yourself – your relationship with yourself Care about people – your relationship with others around you Execute to greatness – your relationship with your team Build civilisation – your relationship with humanity and the world We enshrined our values in our vision: We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that: Connects us with meaningful relationships Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world. And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions: To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society ____________________________________________________________ The Role Purpose of the role You’ll enhance the delivery of some of the most complex and interesting projects in the world by driving effective production planning and site delivery to the highest standards. You’ll work closely with contractors to plan, sequence, and execute the work , using structured planning methods to improve certainty an d logistical flow on site. You’ll translate an integrated master schedule into practical and buildable plans, using lean planning software and collaborative planning techniques to ensure teams are aligned on priorities, constraints, and upcoming work. Your team This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy team which focuses on: Understanding what the real problems of project delivery are Implementing practical, site-driven solutions with contractors Developing scalable best practices, tools, and technology More specifically, you’ll be part of our Project Planning Team, who are industry leaders in the planning and delivery of complex construction projects. Your initial leader will be one of our planning discipline directors. Your top three objectives To make construction projects deliver to near perfection through effective production planning and control To create scalable and repeatable solutions that improve site delivery and logistics performance . To develop yourself and everyone around you, including contractor teams and site supervisors . Your Top Five Responsibilities Own the plan (Production & Delivery Focus ): Own and optimise the project plan and actively drive its implementation with contractors. Ensure plans are buildable, coordinated, and aligned with site realities, with a strong focus on short-term delivery. Mitigate/reduc e delays through proactive delivery planning, constraint removal, and verifying construction sequencing with contractors. Facilitate contractor planning and execution: Work directly with contractors to develop and maintain high-quality, logic-driven programmes. Lead look-ahead planning (2–6 weeks), coordinate trades, and ensure teams are clear on priorities, access, and constraints. Implement collaborative planning methods: Facilitate Last Planner System (LPS) practices including look-ahead planning, weekly work planning, and constraint management. Lead milestone pull planning sessions to break down key phases into logistically deliverable and sequenced work packages. Report and improve delivery performance: Provide insights on plan performance, progress, and risks. Track metrics such as PPC and reasons for variance, and work with teams to continuously improve plan reliability and productivity. Build issuer activation playbooks, launch models and enablement assets that regional teams can adapt and deploy. Support joint growth planning, partner performance management and governance routines. Develop adoption dashboards, insight packs and best-practice reporting for use across the global SME partnerships organisation. Work through regional teams rather than owning local execution directly. Escalate strategic issues, material risks and prioritisation choices to the VP with clear options and recommendations. Role Go-to-Market Planning & Ecosystem Enablement Support the VP in translating global go-to-market strategy into practical plans, playbooks and deployment frameworks for strategic SME partner solutions. Develop repeatable GTM models that support issuer launch, activation, engagement and scale across priority regions. Maintain global GTM assets, sales narratives, launch guidance and implementation toolkits for regional teams. Track progress against ecosystem growth priorities and highlight dependencies, risks and areas requiring VP-level intervention. Issuer Adoption & Portfolio Activation Partner with regional SME Business Development and Account Management teams to embed partner solutions into issuer growth conversations and portfolio plans. Develop issuer activation frameworks, launch checklists and adoption playbooks that can be adapted locally while preserving global consistency. Support regional teams in identifying activation barriers and codifying approaches that accelerate issuer adoption. Capture and share best practices for scaling ecosystem adoption across issuer portfolios. SME Customer Penetration & Solution Utilisation Develop practical frameworks to improve awareness, activation, usage and retention of partner solutions within issuers' SME customer bases. Work with Product, Services and regional teams to define engagement journeys, customer propositions and utilisation levers for partner solutions. Monitor utilisation patterns, regional feedback and performance insights to identify opportunities to improve SME customer engagement. Support measurable increases in activation and usage by turning insights into repeatable improvement actions. Partner Performance Management & Growth Support executive partner governance by preparing business review materials, performance packs, growth plans and issue logs. Contribute to joint partner growth plans by coordinating inputs from regions, Product, Services and commercial teams. Track partner performance against agreed adoption, utilisation and commercial objectives. Identify opportunities to deepen partner value, improve deployment effectiveness and scale successful use cases across markets. Regional Enablement & Best-Practice Management Act as a hands-on enablement lead for regional Product, SME Business Development and Account Management teams. Create and maintain GTM playbooks, partner briefs, issuer-facing materials, internal guidance and adoption toolkits. Coordinate communities of practice, regional feedback loops and best-practice sharing around partner-led SME growth. Ensure learnings from regional execution are codified into scalable global frameworks. Performance Reporting, Governance & Insights Build and maintain adoption reporting mechanisms, dashboards and governance routines that provide visibility across partner solutions and regions. Consolidate regional performance inputs and translate them into clear insights, risks, actions and recommendations for the VP. Support quarterly business reviews, partner governance forums and internal stakeholder updates. Ensure performance measures are consistently defined and used across partner management and GTM activity. Stakeholder Coordination & Matrix Leadership Coordinate across Product, Sales, Services, SME Business Development, Account Management and regional teams to support aligned execution. Drive follow-through on agreed actions, dependencies and priorities across cross-functional teams. Represent the global partner management and GTM function in working-level forums and regional planning discussions. Escalate strategic trade-offs, resource constraints and material execution risks to the VP with clear options and recommendations. Experience & Capabilities Strong experience in partnership management, go-to-market execution, business development, product commercialisation or ecosystem growth. Demonstrated ability to turn strategy into scalable operating models, enablement materials and practical execution plans. Experience working across product, sales, account management, services and regional organisations in a matrixed environment. Strong commercial judgement, performance orientation and ability to use data to identify adoption opportunities and execution barriers. Credibility with internal stakeholders and external partners, with the ability to influence without direct authority. Understanding of issuer, SME and fintech ecosystems, including the commercial drivers behind SME customer engagement and solution utilisation. Strong written communication, structured problem-solving and senior stakeholder briefing capabilities. Success Measures Quality and adoption of GTM playbooks, launch models, issuer activation frameworks and enablement materials. Number and percentage of priority issuers progressing through defined partner-solution activation stages. Growth in issuer portfolio penetration, SME customer activation, utilisation and engagement for partner solutions. Partner performance against agreed adoption, utilisation and commercial growth objectives. Timeliness and quality of partner governance materials, dashboards, business reviews and performance insights. Evidence that regional learnings are captured, codified and reused across markets. Feedback from the VP, strategic partners, regional teams and cross-functional stakeholders on enablement quality and execution support.
